verdict.rationale: BugSnag ships an official CLI, documented under build integrations, for creating releases and uploading files such as source maps from build processes. That is the core headless/CI automation use for an error-monitoring service. A documented Data Access API (OpenAPI spec with authentication, pagination and rate-limiting docs) supports further scripted, non-interactive automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline setup docs (e.g., GitHub Actions or other CI examples), CLI scope beyond releases and uploads, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
